summary: Defines the SiteDocument entity for a site, with unique identification and site association.
purpose: Represents a document associated with a site in the HSPnet data layer.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the site document.

summary: Defines the user interface and workflow for the Staff Admin Welcome page, including controls for date filtering, error/warning panels, and site/discipline selection.
purpose: Provides a welcome interface for staff administrators, displaying relevant information and allowing filtering of employment applications.

workflows.name: Filter Employment Applications
steps: Select site and discipline using dropdowns.
Input start and end dates with validation (required, regex, custom check).
Refresh view to update data grid with filtered applications.

business_rules: Employment applications can only be viewed for the selected site and discipline.
Date range must be valid (start date <= end date).
Withdrawn applications are shown if checkbox is checked.
validations: Required fields: Start Date, End Date.
Start date must not be after end date (custom validator).
conditions: WithdrawnDate is null: status is Submitted.
WithdrawnDate is present: status is Withdrawn.
system_behavior: Error and warning panels are displayed and can be hidden.
Grid is refreshed and paged according to filter inputs.
Employment applications data source is dynamically selected based on filter parameters.
exceptions: No data is handled with EmptyDataTemplate.

summary: Defines ServiceCode and its management, including localization and retrieval by CourseID and TimetableID.
purpose: Manages service codes with associated metadata, categorization, and alternative language support.

workflows.name: List All Service Codes
steps: Localize if alternate language is enabled.

workflows.name: Retrieve Codes by Course or Timetable
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID with session and ID.

business_rules: Alternate language fields are used if session is set to use them.
system_behavior: Retrieves service codes via stored procedures.
dependencies: SQL stored procedures: ServiceCodeListAll, ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID, ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID

summary: SiteProfileHistory entity tracks actions and changes made to a site profile, including user, agency, and formatted details.
purpose: Enables auditing and retrieval of the history of changes and actions for a site profile, including localized fields.

workflows.name: Search Site Profile History
steps: Call SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID and SessionAgencyID.
For each record, fill SiteProfileHistory entity with details.

business_rules: Different fields are used if session is in alternate language mode.
calculations: AgencyUserFormatted concatenates agency and user name initials.
AgencyUserDetailsFormatted formats tooltip with agency, user details, and phone.
conditions: If ByUserSysAdmin is false and user IDs differ, add support team label.
system_behavior: History entries can be retrieved and displayed via user controls.
Entries include formatted names and agency details.

summary: EmailPopupDocument represents a document in an email popup, with support for searching, displaying, and deleting files.
purpose: Facilitates management of email popup documents including searching and file deletion.

workflows.name: Search and Display EmailPopupDocuments
steps: Iterate and extract file name and path.
Create EmailPopupDocument instances for each entry.

workflows.name: Delete EmailPopupDocument
steps: Locate document by ID from DataInfo.
Update DataInfo string to remove entry.

business_rules: Documents are only deleted if valid file and folder paths exist.
conditions: If DataInfo is empty or file/folder does not exist, operation is skipped.
system_behavior: Documents can be searched and displayed.
Files and folders can be deleted.
exceptions: File deletion exceptions are caught and ignored.
Folder deletion exceptions are caught and ignored.
